assumptions: Louvain only, behind a pluggable CommunityDetector interface; Leiden deferred to a follow-up (settled in the fleet CONFIRM round).
Graph treated as undirected for modularity; parallel/anti-parallel edges between the same pair sum their weights.
Edge weight = confidence when present, else 1.
Node community label is an optional, additive GraphNode.community?: number (plus zod schema); back-compat, absent until a detection pass runs.
Detection is deterministic: fixed node order + ascending-community-id tie-break; optional seed applies a seeded Fisher-Yates permutation of processing order.
Community ids canonicalized to [0, communityCount) by first appearance.
Wired into the real `graph scan` build path (after ingest/link, before save) so labels persist through the Serializer; scan output now reports community count.
